source.notes: Generated by scripts/run_openai_bench.py; accepted community submission from @mvdevnull via GitHub issue #6

hardware.pcie: GPU0 5060Ti x8 gen3, GPU1 5060Ti x8 gen3, GPU2 5060Ti x4 gen3, GPU3 RTX2070 x1 gen3, GPU4 5060Ti x4 gen3 - all PHB, no NVLink
hardware.notes: RTX 2070 is load-bearing, not excluded: removing it forced bf16 weights to spill onto system CPU RAM. With the 2070 present, ollama ps confirms 100% GPU residency across all 5 devices (60GB total resident). 2070 negotiates only PCIe x1 gen3, the narrowest link in the topology.

model.source: local Ollama tag PT-qwen3.8-27b-mtp-bf16-102k-23toks, built FROM stock qwen3.8:27b-mtp-bf16 weights, num_ctx pinned to 102400

serving.notes: Ollama automatic layer placement across all 5 visible GPUs, not explicitly pinned tensor-split.

benchmark.notes: First bf16 (unquantized weights) submission to this repo; all other published presets are quantized.

caveats: 2070 required to avoid CPU offload at this weight precision; PCIe x1 link on 2070 may bottleneck whatever layers/KV it holds
